outcome: Rate of cesarean section in nulliparous women with term, singleton, vertex babies
Rate of healthcare-associated bloodstream infection in newborns
cohort: Women over 18 years old who delivered between January-December 2016 and their newborns hospitalized in the Neonatology or NICU of a public non-teaching hospital in Catanzaro, Italy
finding: The study identified significant deficiencies in perinatal care quality based on JCAHO indicators, particularly regarding elective/early-term deliveries, cesarean sections in low-risk women, and antenatal steroid use, highlighting areas for improvement in Italian healthcare.
mod_finding: Elective/early-term delivery rate (27.6%) was far from the recommended goal (0%); cesarean section rate in nulliparous women with a term, singleton baby in a vertex position exceeded the suggested target (<24%).
